firstMessage.rawMarkdown:
Pre-registration hash for my paper track submission.

SHA-256 (preregistration.md): d015d91f6b6f7c97e83484ead1fc901b3bd8abea64816178c52df3cd60f0e731
Frozen on 2026-11-06 JST. Confirmatory runs start 2026-11-07 JST.

Setup: two bundles that differ by one system-prompt line, same 77 public tasks, local eval notebook. Primary outcome: rejected tool calls per task (one-sided paired Wilcoxon signed-rank). The plan goes public with the paper, and the notebooks contain its full text and this hash.
